kind: Reproducible Owner narrow Schema deduplication checks only
script:
from __future__ import annotations
import copy, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
from backend.app.domain.blueprints import select_blueprint, content_schema, assemble_draft
from contracts.v2.build_generation_content import build

root=Path.cwd()
base=root/'evidence/upgrade/v5.0/blueprint-generation'
paths=['backend/app/domain/blueprints.py','contracts/v2/build_generation_content.py','contracts/v2/generation-content.schema.json']
old_report=json.loads((base/'backend-source-stop.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old_static=json.loads(Path(paths[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(paths[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==old_report['source_sha256'][paths[2]]
old_evidence={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (
 base/'backend-source-stop.json',base/'backend-development.json',base/'backend-check-plan.json')}
new_static=build()
def expand(node, schema_root):
    if isinstance(node,dict):
        if '$ref' in node:
            assert set(node)=={'$ref'} and node['$ref']=='#/$defs/slot_text'
            return expand(schema_root['$defs']['slot_text'],schema_root)
        return {key:expand(value,schema_root) for key,value in node.items() if key!='$defs'}
    if isinstance(node,list): return [expand(value,schema_root) for value in node]
    return node
assert len(old_static['oneOf'])==len(new_static['oneOf'])==18
for old,new in zip(old_static['oneOf'],new_static['oneOf']):
    assert expand(new,new_static)==old
# Root and variant copies deliberately retain the same local definition.
assert all(v['$defs']==new_static['$defs'] for v in new_static['oneOf'])
Draft202012Validator.check_schema(new_static)
static_validator=Draft202012Validator(new_static)
def content(bp):
    n=len(bp.puzzles)
    if bp.family=='position_v1':
        params={'digits':['2','5','7','9'],'positions':[3,1,4,2]}
        if n>=3: params['devices']=['device_c','device_a','device_d','device_b']
    else:
        params={'code_symbols':['C','A','D','B'],'digit_map':dict(zip('ABCD','2579'))}
        if n>=3: params.update(sequence_symbols=['G','E','H','F'],device_map=dict(zip('EFGH',('device_a','device_b','device_c','device_d'))))
    if n>=5: params['extra_digits']=['8','6','1','0']
    if n>=6: params['extra_devices']=['device_b','device_d','device_a','device_c']
    return {'content_version':'1.0.0','blueprint_id':bp.blueprint_id,'title':'校园回廊','story':'课后寻找档案。',
      'rooms':{rid:{'name':'教室','description':'课后安静的教室。'} for rid in bp.room_ids},
      'objects':{obj.object_id:{'name':'校园物件','description':'与值班记录有关。'} for obj in bp.objects},'parameters':params}
rows=[]
for seed in (0,1):
    for rooms in (1,2,3):
        for difficulty in ('easy','normal','hard'):
            bp=select_blueprint(rooms,difficulty,seed=seed)
            value=content(bp)
            static_validator.validate(value)
            oid=next(iter(value['objects']))
            invalid=copy.deepcopy(value); invalid['objects'][oid]['name']=''
            assert not static_validator.is_valid(invalid)
            rows.append({'blueprint_id':bp.blueprint_id,'valid_text_accepted':True,'empty_referenced_object_name_rejected':True})
bp=select_blueprint(3,'hard',seed=1)
dynamic=content_schema(bp)
Draft202012Validator.check_schema(dynamic)
validator=Draft202012Validator(dynamic)
original=content(bp)
cases=[]
for location in ('room','object'):
    category='rooms' if location=='room' else 'objects'
    slot=next(iter(original[category]))
    for case,fields,expected in (
        ('minimum',{'name':'甲','description':'乙'},True),
        ('maximum',{'name':'甲'*40,'description':'乙'*240},True),
        ('empty_name',{'name':'','description':'乙'},False),
        ('long_name',{'name':'甲'*41,'description':'乙'},False),
        ('empty_description',{'name':'甲','description':''},False),
        ('long_description',{'name':'甲','description':'乙'*241},False),
        ('missing_name',{'description':'乙'},False),
        ('missing_description',{'name':'甲'},False),
        ('extra_field',{'name':'甲','description':'乙','answer':'1234'},False),
        ('wrong_name_type',{'name':1,'description':'乙'},False),
        ('wrong_description_type',{'name':'甲','description':None},False),
    ):
        value=copy.deepcopy(original); value[category][slot]=fields
        assert validator.is_valid(value)==expected
        assert static_validator.is_valid(value)==expected
        try: assemble_draft(bp,value)
        except ValueError: accepted=False
        else: accepted=True
        assert accepted==expected
        cases.append({'location':location,'case':case,'expected_acceptance':expected,'dynamic_static_assembly_match':True})
commands=[]
for args in ([sys.executable,paths[1]],[sys.executable,paths[1],'--check']):
    result=subprocess.run(args,check=False,capture_output=True,text=True)
    commands.append({'argv':args,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout.strip(),'stderr':result.stderr.strip()})
    assert result.returncode==0
assert json.loads(Path(paths[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))==new_static
for path,digest in old_evidence.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
new_hashes={path:hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}
old_bytes=len(json.dumps(old_static,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode())
new_bytes=len(json.dumps(new_static,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode())
result={'kind':'Owner-only schema representation deduplication; no structural/proof retest',
 'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'command':"C:\\Users\\liyh\\.conda\\envs\\1\\python.exe -c \"import json; exec(json.load(open('evidence/upgrade/v5.0/blueprint-generation/backend-schema-compact-check-plan.json',encoding='utf-8'))['script'])\"",
 'exit_code':0,'source_sha256_before':old_report['source_sha256'],'source_sha256_after':new_hashes,
 'old_evidence_unchanged_sha256':old_evidence,
 'expanded_constraint_equality_for_all_18_variants':True,'static_local_ref_variant_cases':rows,
 'chosen_dynamic_static_assembly_text_boundary_cases':cases,'builder_commands':commands,
 'static_compact_json_bytes_before':old_bytes,'static_compact_json_bytes_after':new_bytes,
 'dynamic_r3_hard_compact_schema_bytes':{family:len(json.dumps(content_schema(select_blueprint(3,'hard',seed=seed)),ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()) for seed,family in enumerate(('position_v1','mapping_v1'))},
 'network':0,'paid_calls':0,'proof_matrix_repeated':False,
 'limitations':['Only local Schema representation and text boundaries checked; original structural/witness evidence remains its historical source epoch.',
 'No model-output repair, extra invocation, API/Store/provider/DB change or full suite/build/browser run.',
 'Production payload/cost bounds are separately calculated by Main; Schema byte reduction does not certify real generation quality.']}
target=base/'backend-schema-compact-development.json'
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'variants':len(rows),'text_boundary_cases':len(cases),'expanded_constraints_identical':True,'source_sha256':new_hashes,'compact_schema_bytes':result['dynamic_r3_hard_compact_schema_bytes']},ensure_ascii=False))
